name: Giant Boar
summary: A huge wild pig that gores and fights hardest when Bloodied.

traits.name: Bloodied Fury
traits.text: The boar has {ref:glossary/advantage} on melee attack rolls while it is {ref:glossary/bloodied}.

actions.name: Gore
actions.onHit: If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the boar moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra {dmg:2d6:piercing} and has the {ref:condition/prone} condition.
